name: WIDER FACE: A Face Detection Benchmark
description: WIDER FACE is a standard face detection benchmark dataset containing 32,203 images and 393,703 labeled face bounding boxes exhibiting extreme variability in scale, pose, occlusion, expression, makeup, and illumination. Selected from 61 event categories from the WIDER dataset, it is organized into Easy, Medium, and Hard validation subsets to evaluate face detector robustness.

name: Wine Quality Dataset
description: The Wine Quality dataset includes physicochemical tests of red and white variants of the Portuguese 'Vinho Verde' wine. It contains 11 input variables describing chemical properties (such as fixed acidity, volatile acidity, citric acid, residual sugar, chlorides, and alcohol) and an output sensory score evaluated by wine experts between 0 and 10.
